picks.title: Jailbroken PS5s can now run local AI models at over 100+ tokens per second — fork of PS5LM goes native, hijacks the CPU, and accesses the GPU and more RAM
picks.excerpt: You can even chat with the LLM remotely from other devices.
picks.rationale: A native fork of PS5LM runs local LLMs on jailbroken PS5s at over 100 tokens per second, using the console's GPU and extra RAM, and it can be chatted with remotely. AI is the whole story here: consumer hardware many people already own is being turned into a local-AI box, a new release in the local-inference trend.

picks.title: I tested the Asus ProArt P16 with Nvidia RTX Spark and it's the ultimate AI creator laptop (with a price to match)
picks.excerpt: A new standard of AI creativity on the move
picks.rationale: A hands-on test of the first creator-class RTX Spark laptop, the Asus ProArt P16, covering local AI performance and price. It is a buy-or-skip input for designers choosing a local-AI workstation (cleared for gadgets by the orchestrator).

picks.title: MacPaw launches Eney, a proactive AI assistant for Mac and iPhone
picks.excerpt: MacPaw is releasing Eney, a proactive AI assistant that works across your apps, files, and system to help you get things done.
picks.rationale: MacPaw releases Eney, a proactive assistant that works across Mac and iPhone apps, files and system settings. It is a new tool a Mac-based designer can install tomorrow.

picks.title: Anker launches new window-mounted camera with 25-degree tilt and local AI detection
picks.excerpt: Eufy has launched the Window Camera E10, a 64.1g security camera that sticks to the inside of a window to watch driveways and entrances from indoors. It records 2688 x 1520 video at 15fps through an f/1.0 lens and saves footage to microSD cards of up to 256GB. Detection of people, vehicles and pets runs on the device, with no subscription.
picks.rationale: Eufy's $79.99 Window Camera E10 runs person, vehicle and pet detection on the device and needs no subscription. It is a new product that puts on-device AI into a drill-free, renter-friendly form factor.

picks.title: HTC Made Smart Glasses That Are Way More Private
picks.excerpt: These smart glasses do just about everything Meta glasses can, but they're not tied to a social media platform.
picks.rationale: HTC pitches its Vive Eagle AI glasses as the privacy-first alternative to Meta: similar features with no social-platform tie-in. It is a different product and maker from the 9-25 Meta privacy card, and it gives a clear design contrast for wearable AI.

alternates.title: AI lab offers free plumbing and HVAC repairs across three cities to train AI robots
alternates.excerpt: Is AI coming for blue-collar jobs, too?
alternates.rationale: AI is central here (robot-training data collection with wearable sensors), but it is not a consumer gadget release. First alternate now.

alternates.title: Nothing reportedly launching two pairs of smart glasses, one with barely any AI
alternates.excerpt: A reliable source says that Nothing is building out its own AI smart glasses that feature ChatGPT integration, a camera,...
alternates.rationale: This is a report, not a launch, and HTC already fills the glasses slot. Second alternate.
